voice.summary: Lattice & Loom writes like a thoughtful colleague who has already put everything in the shared document. It is plain, a little wry, and always aware that someone reading it is in a different time zone.
dos: Write so a reader in any time zone can act without asking
Name the city or the person, not 'the team'
Say what we write down and why, in one clear sentence
donts: Do not boast about headcount or growth
Do not use 'rockstar', 'ninja' or 'family' for a team
Do not assume the reader shares our working hours

taglines: We write it down so you sleep
Software for the people who make cloth
Eighty-four people, no single time zone
boilerplate: Lattice & Loom is an 84-person company in six cities that builds software for textile makers, working across time zones and documenting everything it does.

microcopy.success: Thanks, we will reply within one working day.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Check your connection and try again.
microcopy.empty: No one is at this desk right now.

logo.note: A globe suits a company that works across six time zones by design.
